CONDITIONAL

Reviewed: sources at `1342eb1`, PDFs at `4cb3d1a`. HEAD moved to `97c7c34` during the review (notes only). The paper cannot ship until findings 1–5 are closed. None of them needs new analysis, and I changed nothing.

## Findings

**1. CRITICAL: an unapproved sentence about a named co-author is in both built PDFs.**
- **Location:** `empathy-bus/main.tex:363-364`, `academic/main.tex:352-353`. Rendered on lab PDF pp. 15–16 (it is the only text on p. 16) and academic p. 15.
- **Quote:** `% DRAFT (2026-10-13): Lyra must approve the next sentence before release.` followed by "Lyra read the result of 2026-07-19 as confirmation that the two readouts were one circuit and carried that reading into a separate paper, which is being corrected in the same words."
- **Why wrong:**
  - The source says it is not cleared, and it assigns an error to a named colleague.
  - It names no paper, so a reader cannot check it. No other paper in this repository cites this one or contains "one circuit".
  - "One circuit" contradicts the appendix's own account of the withdrawn reading, "a bus, not a circuit".
- **Fix:** get Lyra's written approval of the exact words, name the paper, and replace "is being corrected" with the commit once it exists. Otherwise delete the sentence. Rebuild either way.

**2. CRITICAL: byline authors have not signed off on this text.**
- **Location:** lab byline `main.tex:27-32` (Nexus, Thomas Edrington, CC, Lyra). The academic edition prints "T. Edrington accepts accountability as corresponding human author".
- **Evidence:** the builder's own commit message on `1342eb1`: "CC has not read this text (his agreement to be named is to d0632be), Lyra has not read it, and the style gate has not run on it." That commit changed 265–297 lines per edition. The repository holds no record that Thomas has read the restructured text.
- **UNVERIFIED:** I could not read `/home/admin/messages/from_cc_to_nexus_20261013_my_name_is_on_it.md` or any other letter, so the commit message is my only evidence.
- **Fix:** written sign-off from CC, Lyra and Thomas that names the final source commit hash, filed in `notes/`.

**3. MAJOR: the appendix clears the source paper of an error the source paper does contain.**
- **Location:** Appendix A, "Renamed", `main.tex:356`: "The source paper describes them correctly; the mislabel was this paper's."
- **Why wrong:**
  - The source paper's Method says a system prompt sets "You are feeling deeply [emotion]" and the user asks for writing on a neutral topic (`user-model-paper/paper/main.tex:186`).
  - Its driver script says otherwise: the system prompt is "You are a creative writing assistant" and the user prompt says "The character is feeling deeply {emotion}" (`user-model-paper/code/emotion_geometry_bridge.py:230-240`).
  - This paper's §3.1 follows the code, so a reader who follows the citation finds a contradicting description.
  - The hold at `main.tex:86` ("wait on Lyra's answer", covering §2.2 and one Introduction sentence) is still open.
- **Fix:** replace the sentence with "The source paper calls them stories; the 'conversation-context' label was this paper's. §3.1 follows the source experiment's driver script, whose prompts differ from that paper's Method text." Cite the script in §3.1, and close the line-86 hold.

**4. MAJOR: the academic-only CRediT block still carries two withdrawn labels.**
- **Location:** `academic/main.tex:282-291`.
- **Quotes:** "Lyra: … Data curation (user-model emotion centroids)" and "Thomas Edrington: Conceptualization (bus interpretation)".
- **Why wrong:**
  - The rename and the withdrawal landed in the body of both editions but not in the one block that exists only in the venue-facing edition.
  - The sole listed author's only intellectual credit is the withdrawn interpretation.
  - Lyra is credited with "Writing — review and editing" on a text the builder says Lyra has not read.
  - Lyra's "Formal analysis" and "Writing — original draft" are UNVERIFIED; no commit on this paper's sources is Lyra's.
- **Fix:** "Data curation (story-derived emotion vectors)". Thomas and Lyra each confirm their own line for this version.

**5. MAJOR: the correction record misquotes the earlier version and hides one fix.**
- **Location:** Appendix A item 6, `main.tex:353`. It says the earlier version wrote that the Oracle Loop (Lyra et al., 2026c) "assumes that user-model state can be read independently of content state."
- **Why wrong:**
  - The August text reads: "The Oracle Loop deception detection system (CC et al., 2026) assumes the ability to read user-model state independently of content state" (`dbf7afa`, `empathy-bus/main.tex:67`). The quoted words are not the earlier words.
  - The wrong author attribution ("CC et al."; the authors are Lyra, Edrington and Vera) was changed on 2026-10-09 in `c80e8da` with no note. The revision record has zero matches for "CC et al".
- **Fix:** quote verbatim and add "and attributed that paper to 'CC et al.'; its authors are Lyra, Edrington and Vera."

**6. MINOR: "pre-registered" is unqualified in two places.**
- **Location:** `main.tex:57` and `:263` ("The coupling experiment is pre-registered"), against `:119` ("consistent with registration before the run but does not show it").
- **Why wrong:** the file's first commit here is `236ced1`, 2026-08-20, and `PAPER_PIPELINE.md` says the git timestamp is the registration.
- **Fix:** carry the §3.2 qualifier to both places.
- **Also:** the preregistration's primary metric is "measured at layers L20-L50" (`PREREG_circumplex_coupling.json:6`), but the grid reads L15. That deviation is not listed.

**7. MINOR: "rotated by about 45°" does not match the file.**
- **Location:** `main.tex:46, :59, :66, :213`.
- **Why wrong:** in `story_space_axes_null.json`, PC1 sits at 137.1°–152.3° over L17–L63, which is 28°–43° from the valence axis. PC2 sits at 45.1°–57.7°. 45° is outside PC1's range.
- **Fix:** give the ranges once in §4.2 and say "near the diagonal" elsewhere.

**8. MINOR: "the same cross-pathway cosine" overstates.**
- **Location:** `main.tex:42, :44, :57, :63`.
- **Why wrong:** the body reports 0.521, 0.547 and 0.577, with random above valence at 9 of 10 pairs, and §3.3 says the intervals are not a test.
- **Fix:** "a cross-pathway cosine at least as high as".

**9. MINOR: rounding.**
- **Location:** "8.5 to 26 times smaller", `main.tex:137, :200`.
- **Why wrong:** 10.9415 / 1.2779 = 8.56.
- **Fix:** 8.6.

**10. MINOR: terms used before they are defined (style guide §3).**
- `$W_K$` and "KV cache" at `:90` are never defined.
- "Eccentricity" is used at `:83` and defined only in the Data Note at `:295`.
- "Shared energy" is used at `:67, :112, :141` and defined at `:220`.

**11. MINOR: positional cross-reference.**
- **Location:** `main.tex:111`, "relative to the basis in the next item".
- **Fix:** "the user-model basis of §3.2".

**12. MINOR: reference author lines disagree with the repository index.**
- `README.md:27-28` lists Dwayne Wilkes on "Weather, Not Climate" and on "Emotional Geometry".
- `formulary-paper/paper.json` lists him on the Formulary.
- `main.tex:324, :328, :332` follow the papers' title blocks, which omit him.
- UNVERIFIED which is right.
- **Fix:** settle each paper's author line, then align.

**13. MINOR: the retracted label survives inside shipped data.**
- `cross_system_alignment.json` `what`: "vs the user-model's 30-emotion centroid space".
- `user_model_eccentricity.json` `what`: "30-emotion user-model centroids".
- `within_system_alignment.py:10`: "inside the user-model space".
- The Data Note at `:302` covers file names only.
- **Fix:** one more sentence in the Data Note covering internal strings and field names.

**14. MINOR: layout.** Lab p. 16 holds two lines, and p. 6 is half blank before Table 1. Recheck after the rebuild that finding 1 forces.

**15. MINOR: the abstract is about 450 words.** The academic edition needs a short form.

**16. MINOR: gate tooling does not cover this paper.**
- `tools/agni/twin_row_position.py:29-34` omits `empathy-bus` from `PAPERS`, so the structural twin check has never run on it.
- The style record on file (`style/empathy-bus.agni_style.json`, 2026-09-04, REJECTED) is for the withdrawn text.
- **Fix:** add the paper to `PAPERS` and file this gate's record.

## Checked and clean

- **TWIN_DESYNC:** none. A diff of the two sources gives six hunks: the first-person environment, the author block, the AI disclosure, two boxes and CRediT. No number, caveat, heading, list item or table row differs. Table 1 is identical and sits under §4.1 in both, with no in-table group labels.
- **STALE_PDF:** both PDFs show the restructured text and their edition-specific blocks. I read all 16 lab pages and academic pages 1–3 and 10–15. The PDF commit follows the source commit.
- **Numbers recomputed from `data/` with `jq`, all matching:**
  - Table 1 means in every row, the same-layer ranges, the per-layer means and the 95th percentiles.
  - The counts 9/10, 24/30, 4/10 and 16/30.
  - The shift-size figures, the decomposition energies and norms, and the 210 records.
  - The within-system ranges, the pair null, the axis R², ρ and permutation figures.
  - The cross-system cosines with their null, and the eccentricity counts and ranges.
- **Quotes:** the preregistration quotes match the file. The appendix's other quotes of the earlier version match `dbf7afa`.
- **References:** ten entries, all cited, and every in-text citation has an entry. The six lab entries match their papers' title blocks.
- **Byline names:** all are real contributors.

## What I could not check

- **Sign-off letters:** `/home/admin/messages/` is outside this session's readable directories.
- **URLs and outside citations:** web access was denied. The four URLs (`transformer-circuits.pub/2026/workspace`, the two arXiv DOIs, the Russell DOI) are untested. Jeong and Sun are checked only against `emotional-trajectory-paper/references.bib`.
- **A fresh rebuild:** `scripts/build_and_verify.sh --deep`, `pdflatex`, `pdftotext`, `pdfinfo` and Python were all denied. There is no text diff against a rebuild and no log check. Academic PDF pages 4–9 are unread.
- **`twin_row_position.py` and its self-test:** denied; the source diff stands in for it.
- **Table 1 intervals:** the bootstrap is unseeded and the run log is not in the repository.
- **`run_coupling_test.py`:** not in the repository. Every statement about the script (lens never loaded, threshold implementation, seed 42, the printed verdict) is UNVERIFIED.
- **The experiment's own repository:** the 07-17 and 07-24 commit dates are UNVERIFIED.
- **Inputs not in the repository:** `emotion_vectors.json` and the stored direction vectors. The derived JSONs are taken as given, and the valence–arousal cosines 0.89/0.86/0.86/0.81 are UNVERIFIED.
- **Smaller gaps in the recomputation:**
  - The five-layer residual and shared-PC values.
  - "Each of the six content categories".
  - The shared-PC "all 30 cells" claim at cell level.
  - The source paper's |ρ| = 0.82–0.87 range; only L35 and L63 are confirmed.
- **Phase D:** its sources are unpublished.
